The unambiguous page-2 map places the South Olive Avenue 1000-foot course in West Palm Beach from the Pilgrim Road area south to Bunker Ranch Road, with the southern endpoint tied to a water-valve cover. No geographic endpoint coordinates are printed, so endpoint geometry is not justified. The original TEAL seed is substantially north of this map-supported segment on the same avenue.
